name: refactoring-economics
description: Refactor agent-maintained code where it measurably lowers what coding agents spend on future changes: git-hotspot targeting with agent share, a repeated-run token measurement harness over the agent's own usage stream, Fowler-catalog refactorings ordered by what shrinks the read set, tool-driven execution with a per-step gate, and a break-even model priced per token class with a safety factor.
